title: RobotConfig
description: Single source of truth for the WRO robot's physical constants (chassis, Ackermann geometry, mounts, sensor specs). Read at runtime by Python (shared.config.robot_constants) and consumed by the Go simconfig package and the URDF xacro. Values that belong to a swappable component (drive motor, steering servo) are supplied by a hardware profile under src/config/profiles and are optional here. Rationale for the values is in other/docs/adr.

chassis.description: Robot body's box dimensions and mass.

mass.description: Chassis body mass (kg), excluding the four wheels. The URDF and the Gazebo model sum it with the wheel masses to get the total: 1.3 + 4 x 0.05 = 1.5, a middle value between both battery configurations.

ackermann.description: Steering geometry shared by the drivetrain and the Gazebo Ackermann plugin.

wheelbase.description: Front axle to rear axle distance (m).

track_width.description: Left wheel to right wheel distance (m).

steering.description: Servo travel and the road-wheel angle it produces. Supplied by a hardware-profile servo, not the base chassis.

servo_max_angle_deg.description: Half of full servo travel, from centre to full lock (deg). A geometric fact from the servo's spec.

max_wheel_angle_deg.description: Road-wheel angle the linkage produces at full servo lock (deg). Measured with a protractor, not a ratio; the ackermann angle is derived from it.

steering_limit_deg.description: Road-wheel angle the navigator may actually command (deg). Absent means use the linkage's full travel.

mass.description: Mass of one wheel (kg). Change together with chassis.mass.

drivetrain.description: Drive motor's measured limits and departures from the textbook model. Supplied partly by a hardware-profile motor, partly by the base chassis.

max_speed_mps.description: Closed-loop speed ceiling at the shipped duty (m/s). A hard clamp the kinematics obey, not a tuning knob.

max_accel_mps2.description: Physical acceleration ceiling (m/s^2). A rarely-binding clamp; speed_response_tau_s is what the drivetrain actually obeys.

rear_steer_ratio.description: Rear-axle steer fraction. 1.0 is counter-phase, 0.0 would be front-steer only.

speed_response_tau_s.description: First-order lag (s) between a commanded speed and the achieved one.

yaw_gain.description: Fraction of the modelled yaw rate the chassis actually delivers. Below 1.0 is tyre slip and linkage compliance, which the zero-slip model has no term for. Measured 2026-08-29 as 0.55.

min_turn_radius_m.description: Tightest turn radius the chassis can make (m), the value of the speed curve at one speed (~0.127 m/s). 0 disables the floor.

min_turn_radius_intercept_m.description: Turn-radius floor extrapolated to zero speed (m).

min_turn_radius_slope_s.description: How fast the turn-radius floor grows with speed (s), i.e. R = intercept + slope * v.

min_turn_radius_cap_m.description: Bound on the speed curve (m). Not measured: the largest value the measured range supports, so the linear term cannot run away.

lidar.description: Slamtec C1 mount offset, orientation and measurement floor.

min_range.description: Closest range the unit can report (m). Anything nearer is unmeasurable rather than clear.

samples.description: Horizontal sample count of one 360 degree sweep.

diameter.description: Puck diameter (m), matching the lidar_link mesh in wro_robot.urdf.xacro.

height.description: Puck height (m), matching the lidar_link mesh in wro_robot.urdf.xacro.

mount_x_offset.description: Forward mount offset (m), derived as chassis.length/2 - mesh radius: the unit mounted flush with the front edge.

mount_z_offset.description: Height relative to chassis.height (m). Negative because the unit is recessed, so the scan plane sits 0.08 m off the floor.

inverted.description: Whether the unit is mounted upside-down. Drives both the driver's own inverted parameter and a 180 degree yaw correction; the two must never be set independently.

mount_yaw_offset_deg.description: Additional yaw miscalibration (deg) not explained by the upside-down mount, added on top of the 180 degrees.

imu.description: BNO085 mount offset and measurement specs.

mount_z_offset.description: Height above the chassis floor (m), 0.01 m.

size.description: Board form factor (m): length x width x height.

camera.description: RPi Camera Module 3 Wide mount offset, tilt and sensor specs.

mount_x_offset.description: Forward mount offset (m). Directly above the LIDAR.

mount_z_offset.description: Height above the chassis top (m). An estimate pending a real measurement.

mount_pitch.description: Downward tilt from horizontal (rad), ~10 degrees down.
